title: bug: a QA session's wrapper checkpoint commits another live row's new untracked file under its own Moe-Task
description: Found by worker-69773bc1 on task-adeabf1f8c9e4e2c8b778491f9e20b71 (parent of this filing). Repro/evidence on moe/work-2026-09-18: worker-69773bc1 created apps/daemon/src/repository/publish-resolve-contracts.test.ts at 23:44:08 +0300; 29s later checkpoint 96db094d (23:44:37, "wip(task-8bc14883...) [status=DONE role=qa]", trailers Moe-Task: task-8bc14883ca524cb99c0dfe667d1399cd, Moe-Session: qa-84420029@2026-09-18T12:43:01Z, Moe-Kind: checkpoint) committed that file plus .grok/config.toml; 68f251be (4s later, same trailers) committed apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-wrapper-main.test.ts. A QA session on a DONE row wrote none of these, so the wrapper's measured attribution is claiming peers' new paths in the shared checkout; the owning row's task.commits then lacks its own bytes.
definitionOfDone: A wrapper checkpoint for a session attributes only paths that session wrote (tool-write harvest) or declared; a new untracked path created by another session during its lifetime is left out, proven by an arm that creates a peer path mid-session and asserts the checkpoint commit does not contain it.
A QA-role session's checkpoint commits no product source path it did not write.

comments.content: GOVERNOR EVIDENCE, possibly the same class, for the planner to measure (not proven the same cause). At 2026-09-18T20:06:32Z the shared checkout's reflog shows `commit (amend)`: a353c62a became 50d7a0a9. a353c62a was a qa checkpoint (Moe-Task task-8bc14883, Moe-Session qa-84420029@12:43Z, Moe-Paths: 7). Check whether any wrapper or lander code path runs `git commit --amend` (grep apps/daemon/src and scripts/ for "amend"). If one does, it is a second sweep vector beside the one this row names.

comments.author: governor-f32726f9
comments.content: GOVERNOR UPDATE, re-measured 20:53Z: the sweeps are probably NOT the wrapper. The shared checkout's reflog gives Moe wrapper commits EMPTY labels (e.g. `b38a6e5b HEAD@{..}: `), while the sweeps carry porcelain labels: 50d7a0a9 `commit (amend):` at 20:06:32Z, and 96db094d and 68f251be `commit:` at 20:44:37Z and 20:44:41Z. All three reuse task-8bc14883's message and the Moe-Session qa-84420029@12:43Z trailer verbatim, which fits `git commit -C HEAD`. PR #56 squash-merged 17s after the last one. So it is likely a human-directed session preparing PRs from the shared checkout. Measure that before changing wrapper code: grep the wrapper and lander for porcelain `commit` / `--amend` / `-C`. If none exist, this row's premise ("a QA session's wrapper checkpoint") is wrong and needs re-scoping.

comments.author: architect-c7fb990e
comments.content:
ARCHITECT MEASUREMENT (architect-c7fb990e, 2026-09-18 ~21:05Z). The premise is REFUTED: the Moe wrapper did not make these commits, and the guarantee in DoD 1 already exists and is tested. I am not planning this row.

1. REFLOG LABELS IN THE SHARED CHECKOUT (`git reflog --date=iso`):
- Every wrapper commit has an EMPTY label: a353c62a (the real qa-84420029 checkpoint, 13:03:32Z), 46123b30, 55eea034, b38a6e5b, bee9e20b, 7986045b and 6e7d910f.
- The three sweeps carry porcelain labels: 50d7a0a9 `commit (amend):` at 20:06:32Z; 96db094d `commit:` at 20:44:37Z; 68f251be `commit:` at 20:44:41Z.

2. THE WRAPPER'S COMMIT PATHS (Moe-s-Tavern, D:/projexts/moes @97df78f):
- Checkpoints and completions are written with `commit-tree` plus `update-ref` CAS: moe-agent.ps1:3926-4048 and moe-agent.sh:3920-4033. A plain update-ref writes an empty reflog message, which matches item 1.
- The only porcelain `commit -F` (ps1:3222) runs inside a scratch detached worktree that has its own git-dir, and only when commitHooks=true. That setting is absent from this project, and in any case that path could not write a `commit:` entry into this checkout's HEAD reflog.
- No `--amend` or `-C` appears anywhere in scripts/ or packages/moe-daemon/src.

3. THE MESSAGES WERE REUSED, NOT GENERATED:
- All three commits carry a353c62a's message verbatim, including `Moe-Session: qa-84420029@…12:43:01Z` and `Moe-Paths: 7`. Yet 96db094d commits 2 files and 68f251be commits 1.
- The wrapper computes Moe-Paths per commit. For example, 55eea034 has Moe-Paths: 1 and one file.
- 50d7a0a9 keeps a353c62a's AUTHOR date (13:03:29Z) with a 20:06:32Z commit date. That is an amend.

4. TIMING: PR #56 (moe/work-2026-09-18 into main, author yaront1111) squash-merged at 20:44:59Z, 18 s after 68f251be. Both governor readings (comment-29007aaa) hold: a session preparing the PR ran porcelain commits in the shared checkout.

5. DoD 1 IS ALREADY COVERED at the source, by Moe's postflight scope scenario J (scripts/tests/postflight.sh:2110-2137, with a twin in postflight.ps1). With peers active, an undeclared new untracked file stays `??`. It is reported `MOE_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED` and lands in the ledger as `unattributedPaths`, never in the commit. Scenarios A, C, D, E and F also pin that a peer's untracked file survives untouched.

6. REAL DAMAGE, OUTSIDE THE WRAPPER: task-adeabf1f's test file apps/daemon/src/repository/publish-resolve-contracts.test.ts landed in 96db094d under task-8bc14883's trailer, so its own completion 7986045b omits it. I have noted this on adeabf1f for its QA.

RECOMMENDATION (for the governor): archive this row as not a wrapper defect. There is nothing to build in moe-next, and the Moe code it names is correct and tested. The actual hazard is a process one: a human-directed session ran `git commit --amend` / reused a Moe checkpoint message in the shared checkout, and those trailers now attribute foreign bytes to the wrong row. That belongs with the human, not on a board row.
